svg.aria-label: The Cupboard map: make something in your own workspace — by asking your agent, writing the file yourself, or having it captured for you — from twelve kinds; use it privately; publish it from a public GitHub repo pinned to a commit; most kinds are reviewed before listing; anyone can then install it; push a new commit to update, or delist it. Each block links to its section below.
